data.title: Peace is a 'dangerous' word in Russian city heading to polls
data.description: TAMBOV (RUSSIA) - "Terrified" by escalating Ukrainian drone attacks, locals in the Russian city of Tambov head to parliamentary elections this weekend under no illusions that the pro-peace candidate stands a chance of victory.

data.title: EU chief to unveil social media, gaming curbs for under-15s
data.description: STRASBOURG (FRANCE) - EU chief Ursula von der Leyen will on Wednesday unveil long-awaited plans to protect children from online harm by curbing access to social media, video-sharing platforms, games and AI chatbots for under-15s.

data.title: Meta chief pushes back on AI slowdown calls
data.description: SAN FRANCISCO (UNITED STATES) - Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg pushed back Tuesday against growing calls to pause or slow AI development, arguing that market incentives and legal liability are the best safeguards against the technology's risks.

data.title: Dead animals, barren fields, and hunger - El Nino chokes Central America
data.description: SAN LORENZO (HONDURAS) - Animals have been dropping dead amid the worst drought in living memory for many Central Americans, who are grappling with the unforgiving effects of the powerful El Nino weather pattern over the region.

data.title: Saudi says Houthis target Mecca, warn of 'red line'
data.description: RIYADH (SAUDI ARABIA) - The Saudi-led coalition battling Yemen's Houthis accused the rebels on Wednesday of targeting Islam's holy city Mecca, sparking outrage across the Muslim world and deepening the conflict roiling the region.

data.title: Ambassador to Thailand plays down anti-Israeli protests
data.description: Thailand has long been welcoming to Israelis in a way some other countries have not, and Israel's ambassador wants it to stay that way, after several anti-Israeli protests and disputes involving tourists.

data.title: Thailand 'must act' as birth rate tumbles
data.description: Thailand is being urged to mount a concerted effort involving the government, academia, private sector, local authorities and the public to tackle the country's low birth rate crisis, covering the entire lifecycle from having and raising children to preparing them for work.

data.title: US touts its power, avoids Iran war at G20 Energy meeting
data.description: HOUSTON - The United States hammered home a message touting its energy dominance at Tuesday's meeting of G20 energy ministers in Houston, while brushing past the consequences of Washington's war in Iran and environmental concerns.

data.title: US military buildup in Palau stirs war fears
data.description: KOROR (PALAU) - US military plans to rebuild the main port in a pristine Pacific archipelago have stirred painful memories of World War II and have locals concerned about being caught in a potential superpower conflict.

data.title: Court orders N. Korea pay Seoul $32.5 mn for blowing up office
data.description: SEOUL - A Seoul court ordered Pyongyang on Wednesday to pay roughly US$32.5 million (1 billion baht) for blowing up in 2020 an office in North Korea that was intended to foster better relations between the two Koreas.

data.title: Taxi boats to run along city canal
data.description: The Transport Ministry is pushing ahead with a taxi boat service on Klong Phasi Charoen, with electric and solar-hybrid boats planned for a route linking 15 piers.

data.title: Messi set for Argentina farewell in Benin friendly
data.description: BUENOS AIRES (ARGENTINA) - Lionel Messi was on Tuesday named in Argentina's squad for a friendly against Benin on October 6, a match that will serve as his farewell appearance after announcing his international retirement last month.

data.title: AI giants pursue self-regulation as safety fears mount
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The world's biggest AI companies are working on creating a standards body, ChatGPT-maker OpenAI said on Tuesday, as fears rise about the dangers of AI and pressure is on to create a safer version of the technology.

data.title: The Bernhard Langer I quite foolishly turned down
data.description: 'No, I can't', l said to a member, who had a 17-year-old Bernhard Langer standing next to him and who was asking if I would like to join them for a game. This reply will haunt me right up until l leave this planet, but at the time I was busy and the thought of playing with this scrawny anaemic-looking German kid was not too appealing.

data.title: Port aim to scalp Japanese giants Vissel in big ACL test
data.description: Port will have to be at their best when they face Vissel Kobe in the AFC Champions League Elite 2026-27 today.

data.title: Negroni Week returns for its 14th edition
data.description: Campari, Italy’s iconic red apéritif, and Imbibe Magazine have announced the return of Negroni Week for its 14th edition, running globally from September 21-27.

data.title: Govt dunks on talk of MCOT-Thai PBS merger
data.description: Reports that loss-making MCOT Plc could merge with Thai PBS are unsubstantiated and no government directive has been issued, Minister Attached to the Prime Minister's Office Supamas Isarabhakdi said on Tuesday.

data.title: The architecture of belief
data.description: For nine years, filmmaker Sompot Chidgasornpongse carried the story of 9 Temples To Heaven with him. The basic idea remained unchanged -- a large family travels to nine temples in a single day to make merit for their grandmother, who has been warned that she may die before her birthday. But almost everything around that premise continued to evolve.
